notes: GOLD v2 initial label (2026-10-18), sc_e0285cea8c56, part 49191061, full part, t ~1.5 mm. Perforated ~100x90 mm plate (1/2) with one long formed edge. Profile verified on perpendicular sections at t=-40,-30,-10,0,20,30,40: plate -> 90 deg fold down to flange 3/4 (~14 mm) -> 28 deg inward kink to the 4 mm strip 7/8 -> 44 deg outward kink to the lip 5/6 (offset/joggle pair, both formed with flat strip between, both >= 15 deg). At each flange end a 90 deg end wall (9/12 at t~-41, 10/11 at t~+43) is folded from the flange (smooth radius 3->9 / 3->10 and 4->12 / 4->11 on v=3 and v=-3 slices); the plate-to-wall junction is a sharp step with no radius (seam, not a bend). Each end wall carries a round eared tab with a hole (15/16, 13/14) folded 90 deg outward from the wall's inner edge (radius on v=-3 and v=-8 slices). Seven bends. Not bends: the formed bosses/cups on the plate, the slot perforation hole walls, the lugs with holes on the lip 5/6 (coplanar), patch 17 (coplanar with plate), thickness/perimeter edges. Legacy count 5 likely missed the joggle pair or the ears.
